interaction: The whole site is a six-column kanban board of sticky notes. Filter nine sample roles by type, area or search (press / to search), expand any card for details, then drag a role (mouse anywhere on the card, touch or pen by its grip) into 'I'm interested' — the card lands in your pipeline and a quick-apply mini form slides open, ending in a demo toast. Every role card also has a 'Move to…' menu that works with keyboard and touch; on phones the columns become swipeable tabs.
notes: Roles and pay ranges are samples, not real vacancies. The pipeline is remembered in this browser only (optional localStorage); quick-apply and the contact note are demos and nothing is sent. Dragging is disabled in the phone tab view, where 'Move to…' is the path.
